claim: The figure set regenerates byte-identical in every format, measured by building it twice in two processes into two directories and comparing the bytes.
status_note: The checklist row asserted a mechanism, that the EPS creation timestamp is the only non-deterministic byte matplotlib writes, and reported no diff. A within-process comparison would have shared the font cache, the hash seed and every module-level default, which is most of what makes rendering non-deterministic.
